title: AWS Cloud Cost Optimization
description: Reduce AWS cloud cost by 25 percent over the next two quarters by rightsizing over-provisioned EC2 and RDS resources, adopting Savings Plans and Spot instances, and decommissioning idle services and unused storage.
goals: Rightsize over-provisioned EC2, RDS, and EBS resources flagged by AWS Compute Optimizer
Adopt Savings Plans and Spot instances for steady-state and batch workloads
Decommission idle services and unattached resources that have had no activity for 30 days

tasks.description: Rightsize over-provisioned production EC2 instances flagged by AWS Compute Optimizer to reduce monthly compute spend.
Apply Savings Plans across steady-state EC2 and Fargate usage to reduce on-demand spend.
Decommission idle RDS databases that have had zero connections for 30+ days to eliminate unused spend.
Delete unattached EBS volumes and unused Elastic IPs across dev accounts to clean up unused resources.
Scale up production EKS cluster from 20 to 40 nodes to add capacity for the Black Friday traffic launch.
Add 3 read replicas to the orders Aurora cluster to scale read throughput for the new analytics service.
Increase node group capacity for the payments microservice to add headroom for peak traffic.
Scale up Kafka broker shards to handle the new event-driven analytics pipeline.
